entities.summary: Thein Sein, a notable figure in the history of Myanmar, associated with Democratic Transition and 2021 Coup (2011–2021). Preceded by Democratic Opening and Rohingya Crisis. Their legacy influenced NLD wins landslide victory; Aung San Suu Kyi becomes State Counsellor and Military coup overthrows the elected NLD government; Suu Kyi arrested.
